optimal.idea: Nodes with 26 children + isEnd flag; walk/create per character for insert, search, startsWith.
Add countEnd and countPrefix ints per node; increment/decrement on insert/erase for exact counts.

brute.idea: Put words in a set; for each word check every prefix is present.

optimal.idea: Insert all words; DFS the trie descending only through nodes marked isEnd; track the longest.

brute.idea: Insert all substrings into a hash set and count.

optimal.idea: Insert all suffixes into a trie; each newly created node equals one distinct substring.

brute.idea: Store words in a list; on search, compare against each word treating '.' as a wildcard.

optimal.idea: Trie insert; search handles '.' by recursing into all children at that position.

brute.idea: For each word, test every dictionary root as a prefix.

optimal.idea: Insert roots into a trie; walk each word, stop at the first isEnd for the shortest root.

brute.idea: Try every pair and track the max XOR.

optimal.idea: Binary trie of bits (MSB first); for each number greedily follow the opposite bit.
Sort numbers and offline-sort queries by limit; insert into a binary trie as the limit grows, then query.

brute.idea: Run a separate grid DFS for each word in the list.

optimal.idea: Build a trie of the word list; DFS the grid walking the trie in parallel, pruning off-trie paths.
